title: Access list: block one host
summary: Stop one workstation from reaching a server network while everyone else keeps working.
objectives: Write an access list rule that matches one source host and one destination network
Apply it on the right port and direction
Check that the rule does not block more than intended

tasks.title: Block PC1 from the server network
tasks.description: PC1 (192.0.2.11) must no longer reach the server network 198.51.100.0/24. Add a deny rule on R1, on the port where the workstation traffic arrives.
hints: Rules are matched in order and traffic that matches no deny rule is allowed.
Match the single host with a /32 and the server network with a /24.
Example on R1: system-view, then acl rule add BLOCK-PC1 deny GE0/0/1 in src=192.0.2.11/32 dst=198.51.100.0/24

tasks.title: Keep everything else working
tasks.description: PC2 must still reach the server, and PC1 must still reach its own gateway.
hints: A rule without a source address blocks every workstation, not just PC1.
A rule without a destination blocks PC1 from the gateway too.
